capabilities: Watch a scanner output folder for new PDF, JPEG or PNG files during a session
Merge scanned pages into one PDF in a vault folder
Review pages with rotation, reordering, deletion and undo
Append new pages to an existing vault PDF with a backup of the original
Name output files from saved templates with date, counter and page-count placeholders
extras: Desktop only (needs Node fs); Windows fully tested, macOS and Linux untested. No OCR and no TIFF support. Community plugin listing still pending review; releases carry GitHub artifact attestations for verification. No network access or telemetry.
motivation: The README says turning a stack of per-page files into one correctly rotated PDF "is tedious by hand" and the plugin makes it a short session.
problem: Scanners that write one file per page leave you to manually collect, order, rotate and combine those files into a single PDF inside your vault.

relations.evidence: pdf-lib for merging and writing PDFs (MIT).

requires.name: a scanner or scanner app that saves one file per page to a folder

summary: Folder-watching scanner tool that merges one-file-per-page scanner output into a single PDF in the vault, with a keyboard-first rotation and reorder review.
